description:
A new married female accountant has joined Wujin Construction, a Grade-B construction company. Eunhye, the married accountant with a fatal charm, lives a life full of hardship and sorrow despite her beautiful appearance. With such a perfectly tragic and beautiful backstory, the men at Wujin Construction begin to take an interest in her one by one…
